messages:
cto_julie: Thanks for coming to the infra segment of the all-hands. Opening this thread for quick clarifications on GPU supply, region rollouts, and the autoscaler canary. Drop short Qs and we'll reply with follow-ups.

mike: small one — do we have an ETA for APAC L4 capacity? Tokyo traffic spikes for us end of month.

karen_ops: target is late May for first APAC L4 pockets, but dates are still tentative until partner confirmations land. We should have firm dates by next Tue.

jordan: regarding autoscaler v2 — any expected hit to P99 for chat workloads?

ashley_sre: short answer: no expected P99 regression. We're reducing the batch window for latency-sensitive tiers (default batch_window_ms from 25 -> 10ms) and prioritizing small-batch immediate dispatch for those classes.

dmitri_infra: canary plan: start in us-west on Mon, collect 48h metrics, then eu stage Wed, and APAC Fri if stable. We'll publish canary dashboards before launch.

mike: if APAC fills up, will requests spill over to eu or try quantized fallbacks? curious about correctness impact.

dmitri_infra: fallback order is: pinned model -> same-region compatible variant -> other-region compatible -> quantized variants. Quantized fallbacks are used only when equivalent model family is unavailable; teams can opt out.

peter: any SLA wording change for Dedicated customers with this autoscaler behavior?

karen_ops: no SLA changes planned. We will surface routing controls in the Dedicated console (hard pin, soft preference, fallthrough flag). Legal is reviewing small doc updates, will share internal link after review.

ashley_sre: quick action items for app teams: 1) run a short load test against staging with the new batch settings, 2) if you rely on exact-model pins, set fallthrough=false, otherwise set fallthrough=true to allow cost fallback. Share any anomalies in #eng-runtime.

ashley_sre: example routing snippet you can test in staging:

```yaml
route:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  batch_window_ms: 10
  fallthrough: true
```

deploy-bot: Canary started: autoscaler-v2 canary initiated at 1951002600 — watch /dash/canary/autoscaler-v2 for metrics.

cto_julie: appreciated — we'll compile the action items and host a drop-in office hour Wed 10:00 PT to help teams run tests. Post any follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
